verdict.rationale: Fathom documents several in-product AI features that turn meeting data into insights and suggestions: instant and custom AI summaries, AI-generated action items, Deal View insight summaries, AI coaching scorecards, a conversational meeting assistant, and automatic key-topic monitoring. The MCP and ChatGPT/Claude connectors deliver data outside the product, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the insights, suggestions and conversational assistant work (evidence is mostly pricing and marketing one-liners), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
